summary.text: Tom France is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 99 who has served in the Montana House since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A lawyer and former regional executive director of the National Wildlife Federation, he is vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tom France was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and earned a law degree from the University of Montana School of Law.
His career experience includes working as a regional executive director for the National Wildlife Federation.

France served on the Montana Environmental Quality Council from 1983 to 1991, and has served on the boards of the North Dakota Natural Resource Trust, Save Our Wild Salmon and the Clark Fork Coalition.

He has served in the Montana House since 2021, and in the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee and a member of the House Natural Resources and Fish, Wildlife and Parks committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Ryan Darling in the general election.
